args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Replace the default base URL from "http://localhost:3000" with the environment variable PUBLIC_URL so that the password reset email link points to the correct deployment URL instead of localhost. This fixes the issue where users receive reset links that don't work outside of the development environment.
